title: Se7en
tagline: Seven deadly sins. Seven ways to die.
about: A detective a week from retirement and his hot-headed new partner hunt a killer working through the seven deadly sins, in a city where it never stops raining.

Beef, American cheese, pickles, mustard.How to make it500g beef mince8 soft slider buns8 slices of American cheese8 dill pickle slices2 tbsp American mustard2 tbsp tomato sauce1/2 white onion, finely dicedShape the mince into 8 thin patties a little wider than the buns and season with salt and pepper.Sear in a very hot pan for 2 minutes, flip, add the cheese and cook a minute more.Toast the buns, then build with mustard, tomato sauce, onion, pickle and a patty.Serve on a plate in front of the television.Crunchy beef tacos with hot sauceMills wasn't guarding the Taco Bell. Spiced mince, lettuce, cheddar, hard shells.How to make it500g beef mince1 brown onion, finely diced1 tbsp chilli powder2 tsp ground cumin1 tsp dried oregano3 tbsp tomato paste12 hard taco shells2 cups iceberg lettuce, shredded100g cheddar, grated2 tomatoes, diced2 tbsp hot sauceBrown the mince with the onion, breaking it up.Stir in the spices, oregano, tomato paste and half a cup of water and simmer until thick.Warm the shells in a 180°C oven for 5 minutes.Fill with the mince, lettuce, cheese and tomato and shake on the hot sauce.Salted peanuts in a paper cupSomerset is counting the days. Pork and beef meatballs, slow tomato sauce.How to make it250g beef mince250g pork mince50g fresh breadcrumbs1 egg40g parmesan, grated, plus extra to serve3 garlic cloves, crushed1 brown onion, finely diced2 tbsp olive oil2 x 400g tins of crushed tomatoes1 tsp dried oregano1 cup basil leaves400g spaghettiMix the beef, pork, breadcrumbs, egg, parmesan and a clove of garlic, season and roll into 20 small balls.Brown the meatballs in the oil, then lift out.Soften the onion and the rest of the garlic in the same pan, add the tomatoes and oregano and bring to a simmer.Return the meatballs and simmer gently, half covered, until the sauce is thick.Boil the spaghetti, toss with some sauce and basil, and serve with the meatballs and extra parmesan.Tracy's Wednesday night roast chickenThe subway rattles Tracy's dinner table. Lemon garlic chook, roast potatoes, gravy.How to make it1.8kg whole chicken50g butter, softened4 garlic cloves, crushed1 lemon4 thyme sprigs1kg potatoes, cut in chunks3 tbsp olive oil1 tbsp plain flour375ml chicken stockMix the butter, garlic, lemon zest and thyme leaves and push it under the chicken skin, then put the halved lemon inside.Roast the chicken at 200°C with the oiled potatoes around it, turning the potatoes once, until the juices run clear.Rest the chicken, then stir the flour into the pan juices on the stove and whisk in the stock until it bubbles into gravy.Carve and serve with the potatoes and gravy.Brought forwardHandle-with-care dark chocolate boxMills asks what was in the box.
